kindNotes: hud.layer-switch: the root has no data-frame (a container: its own border and the 8 px gap)
hud.action-dock: the root has no data-frame (a container: its own border and the 8 px gap)
hud.crisis-icons: the root has no data-frame (a container: its own border and the 8 px gap)
hud.stuck-goods: the root has no data-frame (measured by its border and border-image)
hud.event-chips: the root has no data-frame (a container: its own border and the 8 px gap)
hud.event-chips.market: the root has no data-frame (a container: its own border and the 8 px gap)

hud.status-pill.data: seed 1 stone town: the mode's tag, date, population, food, coin

hud.status-pill.sandbox.data: a new sandbox from the title: the mode's tag (the building words), date, population, food, coin, the welcome closed

hud.season-strip-panel.data: the town's year strip with its marks and the food line

hud.time-cluster.data: the speed seals (PLAY-2: the fast seal's mark ×5·10) and the settings button

hud.settings-popover.data: autoplay, tutorial, audio, save and render switches

hud.layer-switch.data: the three layers, two locked (tutorial on)

hud.action-dock.data: build, ledger, steward (undo when a site is new)

hud.steward-bubble.data: the steward's line (quiet, or the advisor's line when he speaks)

hud.crisis-icons.data: the famine's alerts (at most three bells)

hud.stuck-goods.data: the 1404 manor's worst stuck pile (a kit secondary button left of the bells)

hud.event-card.lord-moment.data: the lord's suit filed: its Wave 40 picture and the ledger's sentence

hud.event-card.family-moment.data: the first child: the ledger's sentence, the child and the parents named, the way to the chronicle

hud.goal-help.data: a tutorial goal card's help line
hud.goal-help.unreachable: the help seal shows only on a tutorial card whose step has an advisor line; the opening card, the one after it and the chapter goal cards (tutorial off) carry none, and later steps need buildings finished (UI-AUDIT-1 smoke runs)

hud.unlock-banner.unreachable: shows only when a tutorial step unlocks a tool; no scripted path completes one (survey §2: no browser script reaches it)

hud.pause-veil.data: the paused town's badge (speed 0, no modal)

hud.completion-toast.data: the carter town's mill site finishing at speed 3

hud.era-ceremony.unreachable: shows only on the tick an era is entered; no cached state sits on that tick (survey §2: static contrast check only)

hud.zone-toolbar.data: the zone layer's kinds and tools

hud.prediction-chip.data: a living tool's placement chip over open ground

hud.hover-tooltip.data: a hungry house's cause tooltip (hover, no tool)

hud.build-drawer.fen.data: the fen's trade cards with the drain tool

hud.prediction-chip.drain.data: the drain tool's lines over a mere (cells, timber, men, seasons)

hud.build-details.unreachable: the HUD's build drawer is controlled, which hides the details' toggle (BuildMenu.tsx: `open !== undefined`); nothing opens it in play

slot.goals.data: the goal log, the settlement line and its progress

slot.goals.drawer.data: the goal log inside the slot

slot.goals.era-console.lord.data: the hamlet's era console in lord mode: the conditions, the plan's primary and where it stands

slot.goals.era-console.lord.plan-waiting.data: the plan waiting on a condition: each unmet one, who builds its project, the lord's lever and its way

slot.goals.era-console.lord.plan-sites.data: the plan waiting on open building sites: each with its age, and the sites the town gave up

slot.goals.era-console.lord.plan-searchi.data: the plan with every condition met and no site open: the town's turn to find the wall

slot.goals.era-console.lord.plan-asked.data: the plan with the town's request waiting: answered on its own chip

slot.goals.era-console.lord.plan-failed.data: the plan after a failed search: why, the homes cut off, the attempts and the next search

slot.population.panel.data: the population log inside the slot

slot.population.records.data: the famine town's population records after it ran (QA-028: the records, not a 22 px band)

slot.ledger.steward.data: the stone town's stocks with the steward's advice open

hud.steward-bubble.ledger.data: the steward's open advice beside the ledger

slot.ledger.steward-concern.data: the famine's alerts with the steward's warning open

slot.ledger.rights.data: chapter 4's rights register (charter rights, fee farm, revolt pressure)

slot.ledger.rights-decline.data: chapter 2's register after a right is lost

slot.ledger.wage.data: chapter 3's wage ledger under the stocks

hud.event-card.famine-answered.data: chapter 1's famine after the answer: the line, until when, the bottleneck left

slot.ledger.lord.data: the lord tab: the four policies (stability), the 10d farmstead subsidy, the draft and the dues at 80%

slot.ledger.lord-refusal.data: a subsidy draft past a quarter of the treasury: the reason written, the set button shut

hud.food-breakdown.data: the town's food split five ways, the ledger and close buttons

hud.status-pill.lord.data: the lord's slice: date, population, food, coin and the way back to town

slot.ledger.stock-lord.data: the lord's slice stock tab: the treasury by estate under the treasury line, then the stocks

hud.command-pins.data: the lord's public work (the keep, locked until the fortified town) and encouragement-zone pins

slot.ledger.lord-open.data: the ledger's lord tab with the way into the lord screens above the policies

slot.ledger.lord-policy-subsidy.data: the ledger's lord tab with a subsidy on offer: the four policies with their icons, the subsidy's notice and its row

hud.event-card.will-kept.data: the father's new will as its chip's card: the engine's deadline as a season, the button to the lord screen's marriage page

hud.event-card.suit-defence.data: a neighbour house's suit against the lord: its filing, its stage and next season, the button to the suit in the ledger

hud.event-card.entry-threat.data: a house's forcible entry forewarned: the engine's warning, the season it comes, the button to the warning in the ledger

hud.event-card.audit-kept.data: an audit's finding as its chip's card: what it found, the engine's deadline as a season, the button to the card

hud.event-card.offmap-kept.data: an off-map estate's petition as its chip's card: the ask, the engine's deadline as a season, why it came to the lord, the button to the card

slot.goals.era-console.lord.past.data: the market town's era console a season after the proclamation: the stone town's conditions, the wall's segments and priority, the plan's past line

slot.goals.era-console.lord.past-years.data: the era console four years on: the stone town's conditions, the wall further on, the plan's past line

slot.goals.market.data: the goal slot of the market town: the goal log, the settlement line past the hamlet and its progress

hud.status-pill.market.data: the market town's pill a season after the proclamation: date, population, food, coin, the way back to town

hud.status-pill.market-years.data: the pill four years on: the slice ended, the treasury nearly doubled

hud.command-pins.market.data: the lord's public work and encouragement-zone pins once the town is a market town

hud.event-chips.market.data: four years after the proclamation, the rail's chips: a house's suit against the lord, the lord's moment, the last decision's trace

hud.event-card.suit-defence.market.data: four years after the proclamation, a house's suit against the lord as its chip's card: its filing, its stage and next season, the button to the ledger

hud.event-card.lord-moment.market.data: four years after the proclamation, the lord's latest moment as its chip's card: the ledger's sentence

hud.event-card.famine.market.data: a season after the proclamation, the great famine's chip (1315–17, the bot's answer given) as its card: its line, until when

slot.ledger.lord.market.data: the ledger's lord tab in the market town: the way into the lord screens, the policies

slot.ledger.stock-lord.market.data: the market town's stock tab: the treasury by estate, then the stocks

hud.event-card.trace.data: the season's news of the lord's decision (the suit filed on the first tick): its year and subject, the neighbour's mind, the way to the chronicle

hud.auto-pause.data: time run in the lord slice until the engine names a reason (the first, a great person's death): why it stopped, the ledger's line and the way on

hud.auto-pause.link.data: time run until a suit is judged: the judgment's line with the way to its suit on the ledger screen beside the way on

hud.event-card.home-petition-variant.data: the pannage petition's chip card in 041's words, its card put off

hud.event-card.registry-variant.data: 031's offer's chip card in 067's words, its card put off
